description: Every acceptance criterion and requirement maps to the test files that prove it. pnpm check:traceability verifies that each file exists and names the criterion.

manual.AC34: Maintainer approves the Trace view screenshots written by e2e/trace.spec.ts (trace-dark.png, trace-light.png). Approved on 2026-11-12 (ADR revision 20); the baselines are in docs/proofmesh/milestones/ac34/.
manual.AC35: Integrator runs the private-codebase smoke run; results stay in eval/results/.
manual.FR074: No CI exists in this repository. When CI is added, a maintainer reviews that pull-request workflows run on pull_request (not pull_request_target), with read-only permissions and no secrets or release credentials; release signing runs only on tags (docs/proofmesh/release.md).
manual.SC006: A maintainer registers Proofmesh in Claude Code and in Codex with proofmesh mcp-config, asks both the same snapshot-pinned questions (bench/eval/samples/invoicing-questions.json), records the sessions, scores them with bench/eval/run.mjs, and confirms both cite the same snapshot id. Last run on 2026-11-12 on the final build, over fixtures/ts-invoicing (snapshot snap_7278727f7dee33d0928b30e7): headless Claude Code 2.1.322 (claude -p, only the Proofmesh MCP server and its tools) and Codex 0.163.0 (codex exec, read-only sandbox, the server passed with -c and its tools approved for that server only) answered the same three snapshot-pinned questions identically, citing the same snapshot id, and both answers equal the fixture oracle.
manual.FR049.publication: A maintainer publishes the signed npm packages and the OCI image, with checksums, SBOM, signatures, provenance and release notes, to the registries; publication is never automated.
manual.SC016.tag: A maintainer tags the release commit of the public fresh-history repository; CI builds, signs (keyless) and attests the artifacts from that tag, including the C# adapter.
